findings: Paper uses alpha.1 and p.5, detached per-instance statistics, random shuffling when domains are unused, disabled at evaluation. Original PACS experiment inserts after residual stages1,2,3; person retrieval favors stages1,2. Mixing final-stage statistics harms classification. Appendix code uses Torch variance. Our preregistered one-early-block 1D native-GAP transfer is distinct from both full ResNet recipes and the earlier class-conditional mild-style experiment.
scope: Targeted sections, not an assertion of line-by-line whole-paper reading.
